claims.statement: Pure, Zotero-free logic lives in src/features/<feature>/logic/ (or src/core/ when several features need it), references no Zotero globals, and each module is covered by a Node test in test-unit/ run via `npm run test:unit` (`node --test "test-unit/*.test.ts"`).

Import style differs by zone: Zotero-free imports carry an explicit `.ts` ending so `node --test` can load them without a bundler, while Zotero-facing files import extensionless (esbuild resolves it) — e.g. reader/logic/readerLocator.ts imports `../../../core/locator.ts` and organizer/logic/docOutline.ts imports `./outline.ts`, whereas print/menus.ts imports its logic and utils modules without a suffix.

Zotero integration tests reach feature modules only through `addon.api` (built in src/hooks.ts onStartup and read as `(Zotero as any)[config.addonInstance].api`), never by direct import, because the modules need the global `ztoolkit`.

Language split: comments, code documentation, identifiers, and log output are English; user-facing texts (UI/locales), AGENTS.md, and user manuals (such as docs/handbuch.md) are German, with German permitted in docs/ and README.md. The organizer is a deliberate exception — its code-built DOM gets German and English texts in src/features/organizer/strings.ts instead of Fluent files.

State of one interaction belongs on the element (expando or attribute), and per-window bookkeeping lives in a WeakMap keyed by window, never in a module-level object — e.g. annotationRowMenu stores the annotation id as `data-flexannotate-annotation-id` on the popup, and print/menus.ts and OrganizerFactory keep per-window listeners/contexts in WeakMaps.

Zotero.MenuManager (via registerPluginMenu in src/utils/menu.ts) is used for the main-window Tools menubar entry; registerMenu() returns a key that must be stored and used for unregistration — unregistering with the raw menuID finds nothing — and registerPluginMenu feature-detects MenuManager so it is a silent no-op on Zotero versions (7.x) without it.

Item-menu, collection-menu and annotation-row entries are plain DOM entries (parseXULToFragment), not MenuManager entries, because Zotero's buildItemContextMenu returns for annotation selections before MenuManager.updateMenuPopup so MenuManager entries never update there while appended DOM entries persist Zotero's menu rebuild; each feature manages its own visibility on `popupshowing`.

toolsMenuFallback adds the Tools-menu entry as DOM only when `Zotero.MenuManager.registerMenu` is missing (Zotero 7.x), avoiding a duplicate entry where the Manager exists, and sets the label via the `label` attribute because Fluent's data-l10n-id sets textContent, which a XUL menuitem does not display.

Fluent locale files are maintained simultaneously in addon/locale/de and addon/locale/en-US (addon.ftl, features.ftl, mainWindow.ftl, preferences.ftl in both); src/utils/locale.ts creates a Localization for flexannotate-addon.ftl, prefixes every Fluent id with `flexannotate-`, and onMainWindowLoad inserts mainWindow.ftl and addon.ftl into each main window.

Preference keys live under `extensions.flexannotate.` (src/utils/prefs.ts prefixes every key with config.prefsPrefix; defaults in addon/prefs.js) and are stable user data that must never be renamed, as must the plugin's tags: `#flexannotate-*`, the `§` heading prefix, `★outline`, and `#flexannotate-outline-<collectionKey>` (key-based because the key survives sync).

`strict_max_version` in addon/manifest.json (currently "10.*") is mandatory on Zotero 10 — without it the plugin is dropped silently at manifest parsing — and must be raised and re-verified on a new Zotero major.

Prettier (configured in package.json: 80 columns, 2-space indent, LF, xhtml override) and ESLint (@zotero-plugin/eslint-config with no-unused-vars off for *.ts) gate changes via `npm run lint:check`; `npm run verify` runs lint, build, unit tests and Zotero tests together. Commits follow Conventional Commits and are made only on instruction; no push, release or tag without an explicit order.

Documentation ships in the same changeset as the code: README.md and CHANGELOG.md update together with a change, new Zotero-internal anchors go into docs/anchors.md, and new pitfalls go into docs/architecture.md; the README feature matrix for Zotero before 10 is derived only from `npm run test:versions` output and refreshed after every fallback change.

docs/img/ is produced only via `npm run screenshots:docs`, never by hand; scripts/docs-screenshots.mjs runs the Zotero test suite with window captures and copies a curated list of ten PNGs into docs/img/, failing when the run fails or a curated file is missing.

Prototype patches are applied only via `assignChecked` (assign in try/catch, read back, compare identity), because a silent no-op (frozen target, Xray expando) is otherwise indistinguishable from a successful patch; patches check the target before patching, log failures, are reverted in stop/removeFromWindow, and require evidence (a test or source anchor).

Tests never touch the user's productive Zotero or Word: they run in the isolated profile .scaffold/test/ (test:versions deletes its profile/ per version), and Zotero internals are verified only against extracted source in .zotero-reference/<version>/ with anchors logged (file, lines, version) in docs/anchors.md.

A new feature is registered as a `Feature` or `DialogInjector` in `src/features/registry.ts` (not directly in `src/hooks.ts`) and defined as a `FeatureGate` in `src/features/gates.ts` — global work in start/stop, per-window DOM in addToWindow/removeFromWindow, both idempotent — and exported through `addon.api` for the Zotero tests.

The organizer is a fork of Lattice (birugit, AGPL-3.0-or-later, base version 4.1.0); organizer files derived from Lattice carry the header 'Derived from Lattice (birugit, AGPL-3.0-or-later); see NOTICE.md', provenance is maintained in NOTICE.md, and license/attribution statements are never invented — FlexAnnotate is AGPL-3.0-or-later unchanged.

Every feature and runtime sub-feature is defined as a `FeatureGate` in `src/features/gates.ts`, can be individually disabled via the hidden pref `extensions.flexannotate.gate.<name>` = `false` (fail-open, switch-off only), and gates declare dependencies via `requires` to cleanly disable coupled entry points.
